newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Everbright buys timber firm stake.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright buys timber firm stake.

text.p: China Everbright International Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to acquire an indirect interest in a China timber company from its parent China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd for HK$449.52 million.

China Everbright International said it would buy the entire interest of Bright Merit Investments Ltd and Tung On Assets Ltd, two wholly owned units of China Everbright Holdings, and takeover a shareholder loan of HK$192.33 million.
The two companies own 67.5 percent of Wellpeck International Group Ltd, which in turn owns 81.73 percent of Shenzhen Everbright Timber Indusrty Co Ltd.
ING Beijing Investment Co Ltd holds the remaining 32.5 percent of Wellpeck International, China Everbright said.
It said the asset purchase will be paid for in cash through internal resources and bank loans.
Shenzhen Everbright Timber produces and sells plywood products and other timber boards in China.

"The acquisition represents a promising opportunity for the company to diversify its earning sources by participating in the manufacturing and trading of plywood products, a business with strong growth potential in the PRC (People's Republic of China)," China Everbright said.
China Everbright International is an investment holdings firm with subsidiaries involved in property and securities trading.

China Everbright Holdings guaranteed consolidated profit after taxation but before extraordinary items at Shenzhen Everbright Timber of not less than 80 million yuan for the year ending December 31, 1997.
